reviewedContract.acceptance: All 20 complete, exact ordered amount/hop-output/candidate/plan and physical-call parity; B median <= 0.90 A, at least 8 of 10 adjacent pair wins, nearest-rank B p95 <= 1.10 A. No positive latency conclusion if any required criterion fails.

findings: Small runner diff confines the independent variable to the hash-bound generic HTTP transport. Both arms retain the conditional amount-propagation file, production strict session/Planner/AnvilSolver, batch64 and shared scheduler settings.

Both frozen runtime registries load full production bootstrap and compile the same real nonempty prefix with all actual-amount wrappers. The actual diagnostic still selects only the distinct-instance rank477 route; offline compilation of repeated rank8 is not a network trial.
Per-invocation state, memo backend and scheduler are fresh. Both arm closures are distinct but package/dependency/artifact/assets and all other source files match.

The unchanged strictSimulate and simulatePrefix guards abort the global experiment before issuing unexpected Rust/prefix work. Completion asserts 12 amounts, 8 GSS and 24 successful no-prefix hop quotes. Final simulation is forbidden.

Source pre/post checks remain inside the existing 30s invocation budget; failures/cancellations and not-run slots are retained. Backend/simulation drains and tracked promises settle before another invocation. Drain failure globally aborts.

Logical issuance is reserved before dispatch. An attempted issuance beyond 1492 aborts before sending; that rejected reservation may increment the recorded attempted counter to 1493, not permit another RPC.

Launcher statically points only to the new runner/spec/candidate and the verified shared prefix-pair binary. Output/log creation is write-once. No endpoint is passed in argv or printed. Launcher credential source code was inspected but credential file and launcher were not accessed/executed.

Spec/runner/input/source/binary/assets are bound before run-mode RPC and rechecked after measured work. Cross-arm equality and timing acceptance remain raw-evidence assessment gates, not a green launcher exit code.
caveats: Telemetry supplies encoded/decoded body bytes and wall-time milestones for backend HTTP. No direct CPU measurement exists; body-end-to-settlement is residual wall time, not isolated CPU or decoder service time. Baseline decoded bytes can be inferred only from verified identity/body parity; its old transport does not emit the new fields.
The 650s wrapper is a cooperative abort trigger followed by physical drain, not a hard guarantee that drain finishes by 650s.
The prior500 reservation is a declared task-local accounting input, not independently verified account-wide usage or billing.
Two arm-local keep-alive pools remain warm across their own invocations. Fixed ABBA order does not eliminate provider, connection-warmth, OS or temporal variance.

Rank477 is a saved post-selection case outside the current live100; this is not natural current-live admission, outer16-route contention, repeated-prefix validation, profitability or systemic Solver improvement.
No outcome or performance claim is supported before the declared run and independent raw-evidence assessment.
approvalBoundary: No blocking finding for the exact hash-bound single bounded experiment as declared. Main retains execution ownership. No retry/widening, live launch, or future experiment is approved by this record.
